The values the National Rates step requires

Source: R/wizard-step_status.R
national_rates_required_fields.Rd

Return the names of the values that must be set before the National Rates step counts as complete: every field of the app's wizard configuration (cd_wizard_config()). national_rates_required_fields() gives the national rates, which are elements of the dataset's national_estimates. survey_estimates_required_fields() gives the survey coverage estimates, which are elements of the dataset's survey_estimates. They are functions because the list differs between apps and is read from the configuration when called.

Usage

national_rates_required_fields()

survey_estimates_required_fields()

Value

A character vector of names, in display order: the key of every "rate" field for national_rates_required_fields(), and of every "survey" field for survey_estimates_required_fields().

See also

step_national_rates_complete(), which uses both.

Examples

old <- options(cd2030.wizard = list(national_rates_groups = list(
  cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
    cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
    cd_wizard_survey_field("ideliv_prop", "instlivebirths", "title_upload_ideliv_survey"),
    cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
  )
)))

national_rates_required_fields()
#> [1] "preg_loss" "twin_rate" "sbr"       "nmr"       "pnmr"     
survey_estimates_required_fields()
#> [1] "anc4"           "instlivebirths"

options(old)
